courses.title: Chinmaya Garbha Samskara
courses.description: A four-module Vedic course for couples preparing for conception, pregnancy and early parenthood, begun in Dubai in 2019 and now run by Chinmaya Mission centres around the world. Trained facilitators cover the traditional samskaras (rites of passage), prayer and mantra, the mind and senses, and approaching childbirth and the first days with a baby with awareness. It is taught in small, supportive groups.
